name: gizza-ai/audio-filter
summary: Apply a low-pass, high-pass, band-pass, or notch filter to audio

tool.description: Apply a classic audio filter with ffmpeg. type selects the shape: lowpass (cut highs above the frequency), highpass (cut lows below it), bandpass (keep only a band centred on frequency, width Hz wide), or notch/band-reject (remove that band). Provide either url (HTTP/HTTPS) or ref (id from a prior tool call). frequency is the corner/centre in Hz (20–20000, default 1000). width is the band width in Hz for bandpass/notch only (1–10000, default 200; ignored by low-/high-pass). Output is re-encoded to mp3 (192 kbps), wav, ogg, flac or m4a. Note: runs on the standalone page and the CLI (chat ffmpeg is unavailable).

format.description: Output audio format. Default mp3 (192 kbps).

frequency.description: Corner frequency for low-/high-pass, or the band centre for band-pass/notch, in Hz. E.g. 3000 to tame highs (lowpass), 80 to cut rumble (highpass), 60 to kill mains hum (notch). Range 20–20000, default 1000.

ref.description: Reference id from a prior tool call. Use either url or ref.

type.description: Filter shape. lowpass keeps lows and cuts highs above the frequency; highpass keeps highs and cuts lows below it; bandpass keeps only a band centred on the frequency (width wide); notch removes a band centred on the frequency (width wide). Default lowpass.

url.description: Audio URL (HTTP/HTTPS). Use either url or ref.

width.description: Band width in Hz for band-pass/notch only (ignored by low-/high-pass). A narrow width (e.g. 20) makes a surgical notch; a wide one (e.g. 3000) passes a broad band. Range 1–10000, default 200.
